# Shree Ashapura Industries

> Your trust, our mission. Established 1990. Manufacturer and supplier of fasteners and machine components for the lock and furniture industry, plus precision turned parts, press parts and plastic moulded parts. Special-purpose products developed to customer requirement and design. Dahisar (East), Mumbai, India.

## Products

Range: M2 to M14 / #2 to #14, length 3 to 100 mm. Materials: M.S., S.S., brass, aluminium, copper, EN8 high tensile, plastic. Kits for furniture and locks; parts made to customer drawings and raw material.

- [Screws, Bolts & Nuts](/products/screws-fasteners): Hex screw, Phillips pan-head screw, Slotted screw, Countersunk screw, Chipboard screw, Machine screw, Special (SPL) screw, Projection weld screw, Step screw, Flange screw, Self-tapping screw, Screw assortment set, Hex bolt, Nut bolt, Step bolt, Carriage bolt, Flange bolt, Projection weld bolt, Bolt + nut + washer set, Hex nut, Thin / lock nut, Nyloc nut, Flange (serrated) nut, Castle nut, Dome nut, Brass nut
- [Washers](/products/washers): Plain washer, Spring washer, Circlip, Star / tooth lock washer, Fibre / coloured washer
- [Plastic Components](/products/plastic-components): Cap / leg (round), Plastic plug, Rectangular tube end cap, Square tube end cap, Moulded plastic parts (plastic compound), Leveller, Leveller bolt, Adjustable glide base, Nylon bush / ring, Nylon cam wheel, Cream nylon ring, Brown 2-hole plate, Cream nylon disc, Black moulded part
- [Brackets & Press Parts](/products/brackets-press-parts): L bracket, C bracket, T plate, Flat plate with holes, Corner bracket, U-clamp bracket, Press / sheet-metal parts
- [Brass Parts](/products/brass-parts): Knurled turned bush, Brass nozzle, Brass turned pin, Brass cross connector, Brass bush
- [Studs, Pins & Turned Parts](/products/studs-pins-turned): Stud (threaded both ends), Machine part (turned / hex / square rod), Taper pin, Cotter pin, Dowel pin, Axle / rod with double-side knurling
- [Furniture Fittings & Cams](/products/furniture-fittings): Cam, Cam lock with keys, Door handle, Bed handle, Threaded insert (ribbed / knurled), Cam connector bolt, Wooden dowel, Slide / clip fitting, Metal cup / ferrule, Furniture and lock fastener kits, Metal cup, Zinc cam housing
- Custom products made to your drawing (AutoCAD 2D & 3D)

## Manufacturing (units 24 & 25)

- Cold heading: 5 machines, 1.6 – 7.5 mm
- Thread rolling: 8 machines, 3 – 50 mm
- Slotting and BT: 4 machines, 4 – 55 mm
- Heat treatment and plating via approved partners
- Also: Traub A25 (1.6 – 25 mm), drilling and tapping, grinding, milling, lathe, drum polish, welding
- Inspection with Go / No-Go thread gauges: a good part passes Go and fails No-Go

## Quality

- ISO 9001:2015 quality system
- First-piece approval, then in-process checks every 2 hours
- Calibrated verniers, micrometers, thread ring and plug gauges, HRC hardness testing
- PPAP documentation; part of Lean Cluster Mumbai
